sents.en: Once the graph is built you query it instead of reading files.

sents.en: Real output, graphify run on the FastAPI codebase shown above:
sents.zh: 真实输出，对上面展示的 FastAPI 代码库运行 graphify 的结果：

paragraphs.en: $ graphify explain "APIRouter" Node: APIRouter Source: routing.py L2210 Community: 2 Degree: 47 Connections (47): --> RequestValidationError [uses] [INFERRED] --> Dependant [uses] [INFERRED] --> .get() [method] [EXTRACTED] <-- __init__.py [imports] [EXTRACTED] ... $ graphify path "FastAPI" "ModelField" Shortest path (3 hops): FastAPI --uses--> DefaultPlaceholder <--references-- get_request_handler() --references--> ModelField Every edge carries a confidence tag ( EXTRACTED = explicit in the source, INFERRED = derived by resolution), so you can tell what was read directly from what was inferred. graphify query "<question>" returns a scoped subgraph for a plain-language question, and graphify path A B traces how any two things connect.
paragraphs.zh: $ graphify explain "APIRouter" 节点：APIRouter 来源：routing.py L2210 社区：2 度数：47 连接（47 条）： --> RequestValidationError [uses] [INFERRED] --> Dependant [uses] [INFERRED] --> .get() [method] [EXTRACTED] <-- __init__.py [imports] [EXTRACTED] ... $ graphify path "FastAPI" "ModelField" 最短路径（3 跳）： FastAPI --uses--> DefaultPlaceholder <--references-- get_request_handler() --references--> ModelField 每条边都带有置信度标签（EXTRACTED = 源码中明确存在的，INFERRED = 通过解析推导得出的），因此你可以区分哪些是直接读取的，哪些是推断出来的。 graphify query "<question>" 会针对一个自然语言问题返回一个有范围的子图，而 graphify path A B 则可以追踪任意两个事物之间是如何连接的。

paragraphs.en: Codex users also need multi_agent = true under [features] in ~/.codex/config.toml for parallel extraction. CodeBuddy uses the same Agent tool and PreToolUse hook mechanism as Claude Code. Factory Droid uses the Task tool for parallel subagent dispatch. OpenClaw and Aider use sequential extraction (parallel agent support is still early on those platforms). Trae uses the Agent tool for parallel subagent dispatch and does not support PreToolUse hooks, so AGENTS.md is the always-on mechanism.
paragraphs.zh: Codex 用户还需在 ~/.codex/config.toml 的 [features] 下设置 multi_agent = true，才能进行并行提取。 CodeBuddy 使用与 Claude Code 相同的 Agent 工具和 PreToolUse 钩子机制。 Factory Droid 使用 Task 工具进行并行子智能体调度。 OpenClaw 和 Aider 采用顺序提取（这两个平台对并行智能体的支持尚处于早期阶段）。 Trae 使用 Agent 工具进行并行子智能体调度，但不支持 PreToolUse 钩子，因此 AGENTS.md 是始终生效的机制。

paragraphs.en: --platform agents (alias --platform skills ) targets the generic cross-framework Agent-Skills locations: the spec's user-global ~/.agents/skills/ (read by npx skills and spec-compliant frameworks) for a global install, and ./.agents/skills/ for a project ( --project ) install. The bare graphify install stays single-platform (Claude Code) by design: use the named agents platform when you want the skill discoverable by any framework that reads .agents/skills .
paragraphs.zh: --platform agents（别名 --platform skills）面向通用的跨框架 Agent-Skills 位置：进行全局安装时指向规范定义的用户级全局目录 ~/.agents/skills/（由 npx skills 以及符合规范的框架读取），进行项目安装（ --project ）时指向 ./.agents/skills/。 不带参数的 graphify install 按设计仅支持单一平台（Claude Code）：如果希望该技能能被任何读取 .agents/skills 的框架发现，请使用指定的 agents 平台。

paragraphs.en: Pi has no PreToolUse hook, so graphify pi guard install registers a native Pi extension (via Pi's own pi install <package directory> ) that runs the installed graphify hook-guard before Pi's read , grep , find and search-style bash calls. Fresh/stale graph decisions and the GRAPHIFY_HOOK_STRICT=1 once-per-session indexed-read denial come from that same policy, so Pi matches Claude Code's hook behavior; guidance arrives as a <system-reminder source="graphify"> steering message. It needs Pi 0.58.4 or newer: earlier versions let a steering message skip the rest of a parallel tool-call batch. The package ships inside the Graphify installation, so install Graphify persistently ( uv tool install graphifyy or pipx install graphifyy , not uvx ), restart Pi after installing or upgrading, and remove it with graphify pi guard uninstall . Only local file targets are inspected; the hook needs graphify on an absolute PATH entry outside the project, is bounded to a two-second, 256 KiB-in/64 KiB-out call, and fails open. The same package also loads in Oh My Pi : omp plugin install "$(graphify pi guard path)" . The registered path contains the Python version and venv, so re-run graphify pi guard install after changing either, and remove the old entry with pi remove <old path> .
paragraphs.zh: Pi 没有 PreToolUse 钩子，因此 graphify pi guard install 会注册一个原生 Pi 扩展（通过 Pi 自己的 pi install <package directory> 命令），在 Pi 的 read、grep、find 以及 search 类 bash 调用之前运行已安装的 graphify hook-guard。 新鲜/过期图的判定，以及 GRAPHIFY_HOOK_STRICT=1 时每会话一次的索引读取拒绝，都来自同一策略，因此 Pi 的表现与 Claude Code 的钩子行为一致；指引通过 <system-reminder source="graphify"> 引导消息传达。 它需要 Pi 0.58.4 或更新版本：更早的版本会让一条引导消息跳过并行工具调用批次中剩余的调用。 该软件包随 Graphify 安装一起提供，因此请持久安装 Graphify（使用 uv tool install graphifyy 或 pipx install graphifyy，而不要用 uvx），在安装或升级后重启 Pi，并可用 graphify pi guard uninstall 卸载它。 只检查本地文件目标；该钩子要求 graphify 位于项目之外的绝对 PATH 条目上，调用被限制在两秒、输入 256 KiB/输出 64 KiB 以内，并且在出错时默认放行（fail open）。 同一软件包也可在 Oh My Pi 中加载：omp plugin install "$(graphify pi guard path)"。 注册的路径包含 Python 版本和虚拟环境信息，因此在更改任一项后需重新运行 graphify pi guard install，并使用 pi remove <old path> 移除旧条目。

paragraphs.en: Both encourage scoped graph queries before broad source searches. Choose the instructions that match the tools your assistant can actually access; neither block establishes a universal precedence rule for your assistant's instruction files. If you use both integrations, identify which graph each queries and choose a primary query path instead of copying two unconditional instruction blocks into AGENTS.md .
paragraphs.zh: 两者都鼓励在进行广泛的来源搜索之前，先执行范围受限的图查询。 请选择与你的智能体实际能访问的工具相匹配的指令；这两个区块都没有为你的智能体的指令文件确立一条通用的优先级规则。 如果你同时使用这两个集成，请确定各自查询的是哪个图，并选择一个主要的查询路径，而不是把两个无条件的指令区块都复制到 AGENTS.md 中。

paragraphs.en: graphify install installs the local assistant integration; it does not establish an MCP connection. An MCP client does not need to run local CLI queries to use its connected server. A locally hosted server still needs its own Graphify installation and graph, while a hosted connection may serve a graph that is not present in the client's working directory. If the expected tools are missing, check the relevant CLI installation or MCP connection rather than treating the other setup's instructions as interchangeable.
paragraphs.zh: graphify install 安装的是本地助手集成，并不会建立 MCP 连接。 MCP 客户端无需运行本地 CLI 查询即可使用其连接的服务器。 本地托管的服务器仍需要自己的 Graphify 安装和图，而托管连接所提供的图可能并不存在于客户端的工作目录中。 如果缺少预期的工具，请检查相关的 CLI 安装或 MCP 连接，而不要把另一套设置的说明当作可互换的。

paragraphs.en: graphify parses ~40 programming languages locally with tree-sitter AST, and maps docs, PDFs, images, and audio/video through an optional semantic pass. Full list: Supported inputs .
paragraphs.zh: graphify 在本地通过 tree-sitter AST 解析约 40 种编程语言，并通过可选的语义处理环节来映射文档、PDF、图像和音频/视频。 完整列表请见：支持输入类型（Supported inputs）。

sents.en: graphify parses ~40 programming languages locally with tree-sitter AST, and maps docs, PDFs, images, and audio/video through an optional semantic pass.

sents.en: Full list: Supported inputs .
sents.zh: 完整列表请见：支持输入类型（Supported inputs）。

paragraphs.en: /graphify . # build graph for current folder /graphify ./docs --update # re-extract only changed files /graphify . --cluster-only # rerun clustering without re-extracting /graphify . --cluster-only --resolution 1.5 # more granular communities /graphify . --cluster-only --exclude-hubs 99 # suppress utility super-hubs from god-node rankings /graphify . --no-viz # skip the HTML, just the report + JSON /graphify . --wiki # build a markdown wiki from the graph graphify export callflow-html # Mermaid architecture/call-flow HTML (auto-regenerates on every git commit if hook is installed) /graphify query " what connects auth to the database? " /graphify path " UserService " " DatabasePool " /graphify explain " RateLimiter " /graphify add https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.03762 # fetch a paper and add it /graphify add < youtube-url > # transcribe and add a video graphify hook install # auto-rebuild on commit + branch checkout (run `graphify update .` after `git pull`: see "Recommended workflow" below) graphify merge-graphs a.json b.json # combine two graphs graphify prs # PR dashboard: CI state, review status, worktree mapping graphify prs 42 # deep dive on PR #42 with graph impact graphify prs --triage # AI ranks your review queue (uses whatever backend is configured) graphify prs --conflicts # PRs sharing graph communities: merge-order risk See the full command reference below.
paragraphs.zh: /graphify . # 为当前文件夹构建图 /graphify ./docs --update # 只重新提取发生变更的文件 /graphify . --cluster-only # 只重新运行聚类而不重新提取 /graphify . --cluster-only --resolution 1.5 # 生成更细粒度的社区 /graphify . --cluster-only --exclude-hubs 99 # 在 god-node 排名中抑制工具型超级枢纽 /graphify . --no-viz # 跳过 HTML，只输出报告和 JSON /graphify . --wiki # 基于图构建一个 markdown wiki graphify export callflow-html # Mermaid 架构/调用流 HTML（如果安装了钩子，每次 git 提交时自动重新生成） /graphify query "是什么把 auth 连接到数据库的？ " /graphify path " UserService " " DatabasePool " /graphify explain " RateLimiter " /graphify add https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.03762 # 抓取一篇论文并添加 /graphify add < youtube-url > # 转录并添加一个视频 graphify hook install # 在提交和切换分支时自动重建（在 `git pull` 之后运行 `graphify update .`：参见下文的「推荐工作流」） graphify merge-graphs a.json b.json # 合并两个图 graphify prs # PR 仪表板：CI 状态、评审状态、worktree 映射 graphify prs 42 # 深入查看 PR #42 及其图影响 graphify prs --triage # AI 为你的评审队列排序（使用已配置的任意后端） graphify prs --conflicts # 共享图社区的 PR：合并顺序风险 参见下文完整的命令参考。

paragraphs.en: Ambiguous extensions. Some extensions mean different languages in different projects: .inc is PHP on pfSense, Pascal in a Delphi tree, SQL or assembly elsewhere; .h is C or C++; .m is Objective-C or MATLAB. graphify has to pick one global default, and when it picks wrong the file does not fail: it parses as the wrong language and yields a handful of incidental nodes, so the graph looks populated while the real symbols are missing. Declare what the extension means in your repo:
paragraphs.zh: 有歧义的扩展名。 有些扩展名在不同的项目中代表不同的语言：.inc 在 pfSense 上是 PHP，在 Delphi 项目树中是 Pascal，在其他地方则是 SQL 或汇编语言；.h 是 C 或 C++；.m 是 Objective-C 或 MATLAB。graphify 必须选定一个全局默认值，而当它选错了时，文件并不会报错失败：它会按错误的语言进行解析，产生少量无关的节点，于是图看起来是有内容的，但真正的符号却缺失了。 在你的仓库中明确声明扩展名代表的语言：

sents.en: Declare what the extension means in your repo:
sents.zh: 在你的仓库中明确声明扩展名代表的语言：

paragraphs.en: # .graphifyrc # A language name: language.inc=php # Or an extension graphify already knows: language.tpl=.ts # Baked into the git hooks (see Team setup): viz_node_limit=0 The declaration flows through classification, extractor selection, grammar and resolution, imports, graphify watch , and the AST cache (a file re-parsed under a different language never reuses the old entry), and the same .graphifyrc is read by extract , update , the hooks, the MCP server, and the /graphify skill. A typo is reported once on stderr and the scan continues with the defaults. How declarations interact with caching, incremental rebuilds, and import resolution: Configuration .
paragraphs.zh: # .graphifyrc # 一种语言名称：language.inc=php # 或者 graphify 已经认识的扩展名：language.tpl=.ts # 内置于 git 钩子中（参见团队配置）：viz_node_limit=0 该声明会贯穿分类、提取器选择、语法与解析、导入、graphify watch 以及 AST 缓存（同一文件以不同语言重新解析时绝不会复用旧条目），并且同一份 .graphifyrc 会被 extract 、 update 、钩子、MCP 服务器和 /graphify 技能共同读取。 拼写错误会在 stderr 上报告一次，扫描将以默认值继续进行。 关于配置声明如何与缓存、增量重建以及导入解析交互：Configuration 。

sents.en: # .graphifyrc # A language name: language.inc=php # Or an extension graphify already knows: language.tpl=.ts # Baked into the git hooks (see Team setup): viz_node_limit=0 The declaration flows through classification, extractor selection, grammar and resolution, imports, graphify watch , and the AST cache (a file re-parsed under a different language never reuses the old entry), and the same .graphifyrc is read by extract , update , the hooks, the MCP server, and the /graphify skill.
sents.zh: # .graphifyrc # 一种语言名称：language.inc=php # 或者 graphify 已经认识的扩展名：language.tpl=.ts # 内置于 git 钩子中（参见团队配置）：viz_node_limit=0 该声明会贯穿分类、提取器选择、语法与解析、导入、graphify watch 以及 AST 缓存（同一文件以不同语言重新解析时绝不会复用旧条目），并且同一份 .graphifyrc 会被 extract 、 update 、钩子、MCP 服务器和 /graphify 技能共同读取。

sents.en: A typo is reported once on stderr and the scan continues with the defaults.
sents.zh: 拼写错误会在 stderr 上报告一次，扫描将以默认值继续进行。

paragraphs.en: Beyond your AI assistant, query graph.json straight from the CLI with graphify query , graphify path , and graphify explain . A name that matches several nodes is refused with the candidates listed rather than guessed. Scripts can read the outcome from the exit code: 0 an answer, 3 an ambiguous name, 4 no matching node. See Ask better graph questions and the query reference .
paragraphs.zh: 除了你的 AI 助手之外，你还可以直接通过 CLI 查询 graph.json，使用 graphify query、graphify path 和 graphify explain 命令。 如果一个名称匹配多个节点，系统会拒绝执行并列出候选节点，而不是随意猜测。 脚本可以通过退出码读取结果：0 表示有答案，3 表示名称有歧义，4 表示没有匹配的节点。 请参阅「提出更好的图问题」和查询参考。

"graphify" and the graphify logo are marks of Graphify Labs; please do not use them in a way that implies official status.
